newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-USAir upgraded to outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-USAir upgraded to outperform.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Friday said it had raised its rating on US Airways Group Inc to outperform from neutral because of recent strong operating results and growing sentiment that Chief Executive Officer Stephen Wolf may soon strike a new contract agreement with the carrier's pilots.
-- USAir's traffic last month roce 10 percent, and its load factor improvement, to 67.2 percent from 63.5 percent, was only beaten by one other U.S. carrier, Gruntal said.

-- Gruntal also raised its earnings estimate for fiscal 1997 to $3.50 a share from $2.25, assuming a tax rate of five to 10 percent. Gruntal's estimate for the first quarter was raised to breakeven from a loss of $0.50 a share.
